SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  COUNT(DISTINCT landing || boat) as num_boats,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(yt AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(anglers, 0)), 3) as avg_yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE yt > 0
GROUP BY fish_date_doy
ORDER BY total_yt DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
  ts_doy,
  ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c * 9.0/5.0 + 32), 1) as avg_temp_f,
  COUNT(*) as sample_count
FROM pier
WHERE ts_doy >= 145
GROUP BY ts_doy
ORDER BY ts_doy DESC
LIMIT 15;
